## Bench and parked

Library tools are available only by explicit request after source and prerequisite review.

| ID | Role | Reason |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `agency:academic-narratologist` | bench | Off-scope for routine brand research: principally plot, character arcs and fiction structure; weaker than skill:category-narrative-mapper for sourced market narratives. v2 boundary override: Academic narrative analysis belongs to Strategy; fictional-story scope remains bench. |
| `agency:academic-psychologist` | bench | Off-scope for routine brand research: principally character psychology, trauma and interpersonal profiles; weaker than agency:research-synthesist for evaluating empirical perception claims. Named theories are not audience evidence. v2 boundary override: Academic psychology belongs to Strategy; fictional-character scope remains bench. |
| `agency:product-feedback-synthesizer` | bench | Weaker than skill:3w-brand-discovery for traceable discovery and agency:research-synthesist for evidence weighting; product-roadmap priorities and preset NPS/accuracy targets are outside the studio method. |
| `data-analytics:jupyter-notebooks` | bench | narrow enterprise, product, or analytics workflow; activate only for matching need Data source reread: reproducible exploratory analysis supports strategic evidence synthesis. |
| `data-analytics:market-sizing` | bench | narrow enterprise, product, or analytics workflow; activate only for matching need Data source reread: decision/market evidence analysis belongs to Strategy, not vendor-partners. |
| `data-analytics:product-business-analysis` | bench | narrow enterprise, product, or analytics workflow; activate only for matching need Data source reread: decision/market evidence analysis belongs to Strategy, not vendor-partners. |
| `design-skills:ux-research` | bench | Weaker than skill:ux-research: generic sample/significance benchmarks, friends-and-neighbours recruitment advice and named shared-drive files need correction. Keep as a template reference, not the lead procedure. |
| `design:research-synthesis` | bench | Weaker than skill:3w-brand-discovery: useful theme/quote template but lacks equally explicit fiction, four-label evidence and small-sample safeguards; participant percentages are not market prevalence. |
| `design:user-research` | bench | Weaker than skill:ux-research-methods and skill:ux-research: short method/sample-size table and interview outline lack their decision framing, recruiting and limitation handling. |
| `product-design:get-context` | bench | Context gathering for product-design work; useful intake support but not design research synthesis. Research acquisition belongs to Strategy, not visual direction. |
| `skill:competitor-profiling` | bench | This is audience, competitor, category, or positioning research owned by Strategy. v2 primary-output boundary: strategy/positioning owns this contract; preserve a single canonical home. |
| `skill:journey-mapping` | bench | Weaker than design-skills:journey-mapping: concise map/facilitation guide permits inferred timelines and emotions with less explicit source coding and current/future-state control. v2 boundary override: client journey evidence belongs to Strategy, not Operations. |
